name: Book Covers by Abracadabrax
original_description:
Create a front cover for your ebook, Kindle book or print book. Tell ChatGPT the title, the subtitle, the author name, the genre and the look you want, and you get a cover in 2:3 portrait format with the title and the author name set into the design.

The plugin prepares a draft that keeps your cover text exactly as you wrote it and shows the image model it will use. When you confirm, Abracadabrax renders the cover and ChatGPT returns the link to the image.

Built for self-published authors and small publishers who need a clean, readable cover.

Limitations: front covers from text only. It does not design spines or back covers, edit an uploaded cover, or copy the cover of an existing book. Producing needs a signed-in Abracadabrax account. If you are not signed in, the plugin gives a link where the same draft opens on Abracadabrax. Outputs are AI-generated.
